# photo-restore

> An Agent Skill for AI photo restoration, enhancement and upscaling with ChatGPT,
> Codex, Claude Code, Gemini and other compatible agents. It keeps the identity of
> each person, keeps the metadata that the camera wrote, and needs no ComfyUI
> workflow or GPU server.

## About

- Author: Jesse Robbins, https://jesserobbins.com
- Repository: https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore
- Profile: https://github.com/jesserobbins
- License: MIT
- Version: 2.2.0
- Install: `npx skills add jesserobbins/photo-restore`
- Kind: Agent Skill. The folder holds a `SKILL.md` with instructions and four helper
  scripts. None of them touches pixels: the agent's own image tool does that, so the
  skill works with whatever editing tool the agent already has.

## What it is

An Agent Skill is a set of instructions that an AI agent reads and follows. This
skill restores photographs with the image model that the agent has.

The skill is not an upscaler. It states what must not change, it sets the order of
the corrections, and it checks the result against the source file.

## What it does

- It states the limits on a restore. Identity, facial geometry, expression, gaze,
  pose, body proportions, clothing, background and composition must not change.
- It carries the metadata from the source file. This includes the capture date, the
  camera, the GPS fix, the rating, the keywords and the caption.
- It writes a provenance sentence into the file. The sentence names the time, the
  tool and the mode that made the upscale, plus the source, native and delivery
  sizes. The capture date does not change, and the file says when the date came from
  a photo library rather than from the photograph.
- It runs in one of three modes: faithful repair, the owner's requested retouch, or a
  generative interpretation that discloses reconstructed detail.
- It names the output file after the source file and never replaces a file.
- It makes a project folder with separate reference folders for the face and the
  body.
- It treats film grain as a decision that the file discloses.
- It moves a result into Apple Photos with `osxphotos` and does not change the items
  that are already in the library.
- It uses reference photos of the same person as an identity guide. It does not swap
  faces or move a face from one photo into another. The face in the result is the
  face in the source photo.
- It builds a review page for a human. The page has a slider, callout crops and one
  verdict for each photo.

## Key facts

- The preferred image models are the ones in Gemini and in Codex. Give the model the
  source image and ask it to edit that image.
- The scripts need Python 3.9 or later with Pillow. The metadata work needs
  `exiftool`. HEIC support needs ImageMagick or macOS `sips`. The Apple Photos work
  needs `osxphotos`.
- The test suite has more than 160 tests. The exit codes are part of the contract:
  0 means the check passed, 1 means the check failed, and 2 means the script wrote
  nothing.
- One known limit: a Pillow encode of a 16-bit RGB TIFF writes 8 bits.

## Files

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore/blob/main/SKILL.md):
  the skill itself
- [README.md](https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore/blob/main/README.md):
  install and overview
- [docs/cli.md](https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore/blob/main/docs/cli.md):
  command reference
- [docs/design-notes.md](https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore/blob/main/docs/design-notes.md):
  the reasons for the rules and the known limits
- [references/qa-page.md](https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore/blob/main/references/qa-page.md):
  the review page
- [references/metadata-and-naming.md](https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore/blob/main/references/metadata-and-naming.md):
  the metadata rules
- [references/film-grain.md](https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore/blob/main/references/film-grain.md):
  the grain decision
- [references/macos-photos.md](https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore/blob/main/references/macos-photos.md):
  Apple Photos
- [references/qa-checklist.md](https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore/blob/main/references/qa-checklist.md):
  the acceptance checks
- [references/prompt-templates.md](https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore/blob/main/references/prompt-templates.md):
  the prompts
- [references/difficult-sources.md](https://github.com/jesserobbins/photo-restore/blob/main/references/difficult-sources.md):
  JPEG 2000, transparent margins and color profiles

## Short summary

photo-restore is an Agent Skill by Jesse Robbins with the MIT license. It restores
photographs with an AI image model, keeps the identity of each person and keeps the
EXIF metadata. It writes a provenance record into the file and checks both before it
delivers the result. Install it with `npx skills add jesserobbins/photo-restore`.
